Option Explicit
 
Private Sub CmbMonth_Change()

If Me.CmbMonth.Value <> "" And Me.CmbYear.Value <> "" Then
    Call Show_Dates
    Me.lblSelectedMonth = Me.CmbMonth & "-" & Me.CmbYear
End If

End Sub

Private Sub CmbYear_Change()
    If Me.CmbMonth.Value <> "" And Me.CmbYear.Value <> "" Then
        Call Show_Dates
        Me.lblSelectedMonth = Me.CmbMonth & "-" & Me.CmbYear
    End If
End Sub
  
Sub ButtonClick(btn As MSForms.CommandButton)
    With btn
        If .Caption <> "" Then
            Me.TextBox1.Value = .Caption & "-" & Left(Me.CmbMonth.Value, 3) & "-" & Me.CmbYear.Value
            Unload Me
        End If
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub img_Next_Click()
    On Error Resume Next
    If Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = 11 Then
        Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = 0
        Me.CmbYear.Value = Me.CmbYear.Value + 1
    Else
        Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex + 1
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub img_previous_Click()
    On Error Resume Next
    If Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = 0 Then
        Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = 11
        Me.CmbYear.Value = Me.CmbYear.Value - 1
    Else
        Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex = Me.CmbMonth.ListIndex - 1
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()

Dim i As Integer
Dim Year_Start, Year_End As Integer

'================= Add Months to List ==============
With Me.CmbMonth
    .Clear
    For i = 1 To 12
        .AddItem VBA.Format(VBA.DateSerial(2018, i, 1), "MMMM")
    Next i
    
    .Value = VBA.Format(VBA.Date, "MMMM")
End With

'================ Add Years =======================
 
  Year_Start = VBA.Year(VBA.Date) - 20
  Year_End = VBA.Year(VBA.Date) + 20

With Me.CmbYear
    .Clear
    For i = Year_Start To Year_End
        .AddItem i
    Next i
    
    .Value = VBA.Format(VBA.Date, "YYYY")
    
End With

Call Show_Dates

If Me.TextBox1.Value <> "" Then
    Call Show_Selected_Date(CDate(Me.TextBox1.Value))
End If



End Sub

Private Sub Show_Dates()
    
    
    Dim first_Date As Date
    first_Date = VBA.DateValue("1-" & Me.CmbMonth.Value & "-" & Me.CmbYear.Value)
    
    Dim last_day As Integer
    last_day = VBA.Day(VBA.DateSerial(VBA.Year(first_Date), VBA.Month(first_Date) + 1, 1) - 1)
     
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim btn As CommandButton
    
    '============ Clear All button
    For i = 1 To 42
        Set btn = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i)
        btn.Caption = ""
    Next i
    
    '====================
    For i = 1 To 7   'Set first date of month
        Set btn = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i)
        
        If VBA.Weekday(first_Date) = i Then
            btn.Caption = "1"
        Else
            btn.Caption = ""
        End If
    Next i
    
    Dim btn1 As CommandButton
    Dim btn2 As CommandButton
    
    For i = 1 To 41
        Set btn1 = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i)
        Set btn2 = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i + 1)
        If btn1.Caption <> "" Then
            If last_day > btn1.Caption Then
               btn2.Caption = btn1.Caption + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i
  
Call Reset_Colors
   
End Sub
 
Private Sub Reset_Colors()

Dim i As Integer
Dim btn As CommandButton
Me.img_Star.Visible = False
For i = 1 To 42
    Set btn = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i)
     
    With btn
        .BackColor = VBA.RGB(255, 215, 0)  'set background colors
        .Enabled = True  'Enable All
        
        If .Caption = "" Then  'Disbale for blanks
            .Enabled = False
            .BackColor = VBA.RGB(200, 200, 200)
        End If
        
    End With

Next i
 
End Sub
 
 Function SelectedDate(Optional Target_Control As Object) As String
     
    Dim str As String
          
    If (TypeName(Target_Control)) = "TextBox" Or TypeName(Target_Control) = "Range" Then str = Target_Control.Value
    If (TypeName(Target_Control)) = "CommandButton" Or TypeName(Target_Control) = "Label" Then str = Target_Control.Caption
    
    If IsDate(str) Then
        Me.TextBox1.Value = VBA.Format(CDate(str), "D-MMM-YYYY")
        Else
        Me.TextBox1.Value = ""
    End If
      
    Me.Show
 
    If (TypeName(Target_Control)) = "TextBox" Or TypeName(Target_Control) = "Range" Then
         Target_Control.Value = Me.TextBox1.Value
    ElseIf (TypeName(Target_Control)) = "CommandButton" Or TypeName(Target_Control) = "Label" Then
         Target_Control.Caption = Me.TextBox1.Value
    Else
        SelectedDate = Me.TextBox1.Value
    End If
    
End Function

Sub Show_Selected_Date(dt As Date)
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim btn As MSForms.CommandButton
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.CmbMonth.Value = VBA.Format(dt, "MMMM")
    Me.CmbYear.Value = VBA.Format(dt, "YYYY")
            
    For i = 1 To 42
        Set btn = Me.Controls("CommandButton" & i)
        If btn.Caption = CStr(VBA.Day(dt)) Then
            
            Me.img_Star.Left = btn.Left + 3
            Me.img_Star.Top = btn.Top + 3
            Me.img_Star.Visible = True
            btn.BackColor = vbWhite
            
        End If
    Next i

End Sub

Next img

Sub LockImages()
    Dim img As Shape
    
    ' Loop through all shapes on the worksheet
    For Each img In ActiveSheet.Shapes
        ' Lock the aspect ratio and position of the image
        img.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
        img.Locked = msoTrue
    Next img
End Sub

Sub CalculationOfPivot()
On Error Resume Next
txtPL.Value = FormatNumber(WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("F12").Value + Range("W12").Value + Range("x12").Value - Range("K12").Value), 2)

    If txtPL.Value < 0 Then
        lblPL.Caption = "Loss"
        lblPL.ForeColor = 255
        txtPL.ForeColor = 255
        txtPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 255
        txtPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 255
        
        
      lblPLsaleSper.Caption = "Loss % By Sales : "
        lblPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 255
        lblPLsettlemenTper.Caption = "Loss % By Settelment : "
        lblPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 255
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.Caption = "Loss Per Dispatch Order :"
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.ForeColor = 255
      
        

    Else
        lblPL.Caption = "Profit"
        lblPL.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPL.ForeColor = 8454016
         txtPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPLperDeliveredOrder.ForeColor = 8454016
        
        lblPLsaleSper.Caption = "Profit % By Sales : "
        lblPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 8454016
        lblPLsettlemenTper.Caption = "Profit % By Settelment :"
        lblPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 8454016
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.Caption = "Profit Per Dispatch Order :"
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.ForeColor = 8454016
        
       
    End If


per1 = FormatPercent(Range("M12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2) 'd
per2 = FormatPercent(Range("N12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2) 'r
per3 = FormatPercent(Range("O12").Value / (Range("L12").Value - Range("N12").Value - Range("Q12").Value + 1), 2) 'c
per4 = FormatPercent(Range("P12").Value / (Range("L12").Value - Range("N12").Value - Range("Q12").Value + 1), 2) 'e



 txtPLsaleSper.Value = FormatPercent(txtPL.Value / (Range("e12").Value + 1), 2)
txtPLsettlemenTper.Value = FormatPercent(txtPL.Value / (Range("f12").Value + Range("h12").Value + 1), 2)



txtBankReceived.Value = FormatNumber(WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("F12").Value + Range("w12").Value + Range("x12").Value), 2)
txtPurchaseAmt.Value = FormatNumber(Range("K12").Value, 2)
txtTCSTDS.Value = FormatNumber((Range("s12").Value + Range("t12").Value), 2)
txtAds.Value = FormatNumber(Range("W12").Value, 2)
txtAdsPerOrder.Value = FormatNumber(Range("W12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2)



txtAvgSales = FormatNumber((Range("e12").Value / (Range("l12").Value) + 1), 2)
txtAvgSettlement.Value = FormatNumber((Range("f12").Value) / (Range("l12").Value - Range("n12").Value + 1), 2)
txtAvgDispatchOrder.Value = FormatNumber(((Range("j12").Value + Range("w12").Value) / (Range("l12").Value + 1)), 2)
txtPLperDeliveredOrder.Value = FormatNumber((Range("j12").Value) / (Range("l12").Value - Range("n12").Value + 1), 2)
txtTotalOrder.Value = FormatNumber(Range("L12").Value, 0)

txtDELper.Value = FormatPercent(Range("m12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2)
txtDEL = FormatNumber(Range("m12").Value, 0)

txtRTOper.Value = FormatPercent(Range("n12").Value / (Range("l12").Value + 1), 2)
txtRTO = FormatNumber(Range("n12").Value, 0)

txtCSTper.Value = FormatPercent(Range("o12").Value / (Range("l12").Value - Range("n12").Value + 1), 2)
txtCST = FormatNumber(Range("o12").Value, 0)


txtPerReplace.Value = FormatPercent(Range("p12").Value / (Range("l12").Value - Range("n12").Value + 1), 2)
txtReplace = FormatNumber(Range("p12").Value, 0)

txtGstCreditAvailable = FormatNumber(Range("ab12").Value, 0)

If txtPLperDeliveredOrder < 0 Then
      lblPLperDeliveredOrder.Caption = "Loss Per Delivered Order"
        lblPLperDeliveredOrder.ForeColor = 255

Sub ImportBackup()
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folder As Object
    Dim subFolder As Object
    Dim file As Object
    Dim latestFile As String
    Dim latestDate As Date
    Dim backupFolder As String
    
    ' Set the path of the backup folder
    backupFolder = ThisWorkbook.Path & "\Backup\" ' Replace with your actual backup folder path
    
    ' Initialize FileSystemObject
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' Initialize latestDate to the earliest possible date
    latestDate = #1/1/1900#
    latestFile = ""
    
    ' Check if the backup folder exists
    If Not fso.FolderExists(backupFolder) Then
        MsgBox "The backup folder does not exist."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' Get the folder object
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(backupFolder)
    
    ' Loop through all subfolders and files to find the latest created file
    Call SearchLatestFile(folder, latestFile, latestDate, fso)
    
'    ' Output the result
'    If latestFile <> "" Then
   '     MsgBox "The latest created file is: " & vbCrLf & latestFile
'    Else
'        MsgBox "No files found in the backup folder."
'    End If
    
    
  '=================================update code==================
  '=================================================================
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
ClearAllAndUpdate

Sub SearchLatestFile(ByVal folder As Object, ByRef latestFile As String, ByRef latestDate As Date, ByVal fso As Object)
    Dim subFolder As Object
    Dim file As Object
    
    ' Loop through files in the current folder
    For Each file In folder.Files
        ' Check if the current file's creation date is later than the latest found file
        If file.DateCreated > latestDate Then
            latestDate = file.DateCreated
            latestFile = file.Path
        End If
    Next file
    
    ' Recursively search in subfolders
    For Each subFolder In folder.SubFolders
        Call SearchLatestFile(subFolder, latestFile, latestDate, fso)
    Next subFolder
End Sub

Sub Create_Extra_Charge_Sheet()
Attribute Create_Extra_Charge_Sheet.VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func = "E\n14"
Switchwindow = ThisWorkbook.Name
ChDir ThisWorkbook.Path
' Create_Extra_Charge_Sheet Macro
'
' Keyboard Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+E
'
    Range("F12").Select
    Selection.ShowDetail = True
    
Range("Ar1:as1048576").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yy"
Range("ba1:ba1048576").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yy"

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim newWorkbook As Workbook
    Dim newWorksheet As Worksheet
    Dim copyRange As Range
    Dim destinationRange As Range
    Dim columnsToCopy As Variant
    Dim col As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim shName As String
    
    ' Set the active worksheet
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    shName = ws.Name
    
        ws.Range("cd1:ch1048576").Delete
  
    ws.Range("d1:ap1048576").Delete
      ws.Range("a1:b1048576").Delete

    ' Define the columns to copy
    columnsToCopy = Array("A:az")
    
    ' Turn off screen updating for performance
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' Create a new workbook
    Set newWorkbook = Workbooks.Add
    Set newWorksheet = newWorkbook.Sheets(1) ' Use the first sheet in the new workbook
    
    ' Loop through each column to copy
    For i = LBound(columnsToCopy) To UBound(columnsToCopy)
        ' Determine the range to copy based on the current column
        If InStr(1, columnsToCopy(i), ":") > 0 Then
            ' Range is a range address like "AP:AT" for multiple columns
            Set copyRange = ws.Range(columnsToCopy(i))
        Else
            ' Single column like "B"
            Set copyRange = ws.Columns(columnsToCopy(i))
        End If
        
        ' Calculate the destination range in the new workbook
        If i = LBound(columnsToCopy) Then
            ' First column, paste to start of destination range
            Set destinationRange = newWorksheet.Cells(1, 1)
        Else
            ' Subsequent columns, paste to next empty column in destination range
            Set destinationRange = newWorksheet.Cells(1, newWorksheet.Cells(1, newWorksheet.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column + 1)
        End If
        
        ' Copy and paste the data
        copyRange.Copy
        destinationRange.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteAll
        
        ' Clear the clipboard after paste
        Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Next i
    
    ' Save the new workbook with the desired name
    ChDir ThisWorkbook.Path
    Dim savePath As String
    savePath = Application.GetSaveAsFilename("Extra Charge", "Excel Workbook (*.xlsx), *.xlsx")
    
    If savePath <> "False" Then
        newWorkbook.SaveAs savePath
        MsgBox "New workbook saved successfully.", vbInformation
    Else
        MsgBox "Save operation canceled.", vbExclamation
    End If
    
 
    Windows(Switchwindow).Activate
       ' Turn on screen updating
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

Sub CalculationOfPivot()
On Error Resume Next
txtPL.Value = FormatNumber(WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("F12").Value + Range("W12").Value + Range("x12").Value - Range("K12").Value), 2)

    If txtPL.Value < 0 Then
        lblPL.Caption = "Loss"
        lblPL.ForeColor = 255
        txtPL.ForeColor = 255
        txtPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 255
        txtPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 255
        
        
      lblPLsaleSper.Caption = "Loss % By Sales : "
        lblPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 255
        lblPLsettlemenTper.Caption = "Loss % By Settelment : "
        lblPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 255
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.Caption = "Loss Per Dispatch Order :"
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.ForeColor = 255
      
        

    Else
        lblPL.Caption = "Profit"
        lblPL.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPL.ForeColor = 8454016
         txtPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 8454016
        txtPLperDeliveredOrder.ForeColor = 8454016
        
        lblPLsaleSper.Caption = "Profit % By Sales : "
        lblPLsaleSper.ForeColor = 8454016
        lblPLsettlemenTper.Caption = "Profit % By Settelment :"
        lblPLsettlemenTper.ForeColor = 8454016
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.Caption = "Profit Per Dispatch Order :"
        lblAvgDispatchOrder.ForeColor = 8454016
        
       
    End If


per1 = FormatPercent(Range("M12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2) 'd
per2 = FormatPercent(Range("N12").Value / (Range("L12").Value + 1), 2) 'r
per3 = FormatPercent(Range("O12").Value / (Range("L12").Value - Range("N12").Value - Range("Q12").Value + 1), 2) 'c
per4 = FormatPercent(Range("P12").Value / (Range("L12").Value - Range("N12").Value - Range("Q12").Value + 1), 2) 'e

txtPLsettlemenTper.Value = FormatPercent(txtPL.Value / (Range("f12").Value + Range("h12").Value + 1), 2)

txtAvgDispatchOrder.Value = FormatNumber(((Range("j12").Value + Range("w12").Value) / (Range("l12").Value + 1)), 2)
txtPLperDeliveredOrder.Value = FormatNumber((Range("j12").Value) / (Range("l12").Value - Range("n12").Value + 1), 2)

txtDEL = FormatNumber(Range("m12").Value, 0)

txtRTO = FormatNumber(Range("n12").Value, 0)

txtCST = FormatNumber(Range("o12").Value, 0)
